mapper.sql: SELECT U.UNIT_CODE,U.UNIT_NAME_MSG_CODE,U.UNIT_TYPE_CODE,U.QUANTITY_SCALE,U.BASE_UNIT_CODE,U.TO_BASE_FACTOR FROM TB_UNIT U JOIN TB_COMMON_CODE C ON C.CODE_GROUP=U.UNIT_TYPE_GROUP AND C.CODE=U.UNIT_TYPE_CODE AND C.USE_YN='Y' JOIN TB_COMMON_CODE_GROUP G ON G.CODE_GROUP=C.CODE_GROUP AND G.USE_YN='Y' WHERE U.USE_YN='Y' AND (U.BASE_UNIT_CODE IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_UNIT B WHERE B.UNIT_CODE=U.BASE_UNIT_CODE AND B.USE_YN='Y'))
mapper.select: SELECT CURRENCY_CODE,CURRENCY_NAME_MSG_CODE,MINOR_UNIT_DIGITS,NUMERIC_CODE FROM TB_CURRENCY WHERE USE_YN='Y' ORDER BY SORT_ORDER,CURRENCY_CODE
SELECT CURRENCY_CODE,CURRENCY_NAME_MSG_CODE,MINOR_UNIT_DIGITS,NUMERIC_CODE FROM TB_CURRENCY WHERE USE_YN='Y' AND CURRENCY_CODE=#{currencyCode}
SELECT MENU_ID,MENU_CODE FROM TB_MENU WHERE USE_YN='Y' AND MENU_TYPE!='GROUP' AND MENU_CODE=#{menuCode}
SELECT MENU_ID,FIELD_CODE,CURRENCY_CODE,DISPLAY_DIVISOR,DECIMAL_PLACES,ROUNDING_MODE,UNIT_LABEL_MSG_CODE FROM TB_MENU_AMOUNT_FORMAT WHERE MENU_ID=#{menuId} AND USE_YN='Y' ORDER BY FIELD_CODE
